memories_or_initialization.description: 寄存器堆用存储数组实现：RegsH/RegsL 为 8x8bit memory（tv80_reg.v:44-45），tv80_reg.v:47-54 同步写入，tv80_reg.v:56-61 异步读出；无初始化值，上电内容未知

unsupported_or_nonsynthesizable.description: 所有时序赋值带 #1 延迟（tv80s.v:102-155、tv80_core.v:314 起各 always 块），综合通常忽略；tv80_core.v:991、1017 default 分支给 BusB 赋 8'hxx（don't care）；tv80s.v:157 注释写 negedge reset_n 但实际敏感表仅 posedge clk（tv80s.v:98）

existing_sdc.basis: constraints/timing.sdc:1 create_clock [get_ports clk] -period 5；tv80s.v:38 顶层确有输入端口 clk，设计为单时钟（tv80s.v:98、tv80_core.v:310 等均 posedge clk），该约束与顶层端口匹配

ports.name: wait_n
ports.basis: tv80s.v:39；功能控制输入，tv80s.v:116/154 作为就绪握手条件

ports.name: di
ports.basis: tv80s.v:52 input [7:0] di；tv80s.v:154-155 数据寄存

clocks.name: clk
clocks.basis: constraints/timing.sdc:1 create_clock 于端口 clk；tv80s.v:38 input clk；全部时序逻辑为 posedge clk（tv80s.v:98、tv80_core.v:310/796/956/1027/1070/1105），无分频/倍频结构（cen 恒为 1，tv80s.v:69）

resets.basis: tv80s.v:98-107 always @(posedge clk) 内 if(!reset_n) 复位，敏感表无 negedge；tv80_core.v:310-341、1073-1079、1107-1122 同为 posedge clk 同步复位

io_clock_associations.basis: tv80_core.v:1163/1173 等在 posedge clk 逻辑中作为等待条件
tv80_core.v:1090-1094 NMI 边沿检测于 posedge clk
tv80s.v:154-155 di_reg <= di 于 posedge clk；tv80_core.v:1055 组合使用
tv80_core.v:1105-1243 posedge clk 寄存输出 m1_n
tv80s.v:98-157 posedge clk 寄存 mreq_n
tv80s.v:98-157 posedge clk 寄存 iorq_n
tv80s.v:98-157 posedge clk 寄存 rd_n
tv80s.v:98-157 posedge clk 寄存 wr_n
tv80_core.v:1027-1047 posedge clk 寄存 rfsh_n
halt_n = ~Halt_FF (tv80_core.v:1056)，Halt_FF 于 posedge clk 更新 (tv80_core.v:1180)
busak_n = ~BusAck (tv80_core.v:1057)，BusAck 于 posedge clk 更新 (tv80_core.v:1184)
A 于 posedge clk 多处寄存 (tv80_core.v:315、378-379、452-560)
tv80_core.v:734-744 do <= BusB 于 posedge clk (tv80_core.v:310)

unresolved: 顶层参数未被传递：tv80s 声明 Mode/T2Write/IOWait（tv80s.v:32-34），但实例化 tv80_core 时无 #(…) 参数映射（tv80s.v:71-96），覆盖顶层参数不会影响内部实现，实际生效的是 tv80_core 内默认 Mode=1、IOWait=1（tv80_core.v:35-36）
tv80s.v:157 注释称 'posedge clk or negedge reset_n'，与 tv80s.v:98 实际敏感表不符，已按实际代码判定为同步复位
